name: web-dark-blue-404-page-with-planet-horizon-glow
title: Dark navy 404 page with silver numerals rising from a glowing blue planet horizon in a rounded frame
whatItIs: A dark navy canvas with a thick rounded screen frame containing a thin nav, giant pale silver '404' half hidden behind a glowing blue planet curve, a centred explanation and a glowing outlined 'Go to Home Page' pill.
whatItMeans: Calm and cosmic; the planet horizon turns an error into a scene.
techniques: Use a glowing arc as a horizon behind big numerals.
Outline the button with a soft blue halo.
Frame the page in a rounded bezel.

vocabulary.definition: A glowing curved edge suggesting a planet.
A button with a soft glow outline.
A thick rounded border around a screen.
